item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00082","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C22","C16","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C22","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C22 plausibly supplied the immediate drafting template. Both are short memoranda to the same officials, open by characterizing the Red Cross and noting the established support of Federal employees and military personnel, identify March as the month of its annual fund appeal, and close by urging a strong Federal response. The child compresses and updates C22 while adding a summary of Red Cross services and the fact that this is one of three authorized campaigns. C16 is also a strong structural antecedent, but its longer discussion of the governing fund-raising policy and specific 1957 conditions is less closely reflected in the child. C04 shares the same campaign genre and service descriptions but is less similar in operative sequence and wording.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The American Red Cross makes its annual appeal for funds in the month of March.","parent_excerpt":"In March, therefore, when the Red Cross makes its annual appeal for funds","explanation":"Distinctive near-verbatim identification of the annual Red Cross appeal and its March timing."},{"child_excerpt":"Employees of the Federal Government, and members of the military establishment, have long given generous support","parent_excerpt":"Federal employees and military personnel have long given their support to its programs.","explanation":"Closely parallel language identifying the same two constituencies and their longstanding support."},{"child_excerpt":"I hope you will encourage this fine tradition during the coming campaign in March.","parent_excerpt":"I am sure that officials and employees throughout the Federal establishment, together with military and civilian personnel overseas, will help make this a memorable campaign","explanation":"Both conclude with a presidential appeal for Federal personnel to support the forthcoming Red Cross campaign."},{"child_excerpt":"During the year it responds to emergency calls for help from communities stricken by natural disaster","parent_excerpt":"The past year has been a costly one for the Red Cross. Disaster reserves have been exhausted","explanation":"Both use the Red Cross's disaster-relief role as a central justification for the annual appeal, though the child generalizes the prior year's specific circumstances."}]}
